impact.text: Later depositors buy worthless shares; their funds are effectively stolen.

precondition_sources.text: The HypoVault constructor pre-sets totalSupply to 1 000 000.
At that point the vault owns zero underlying assets.
Before the first fulfilment computeNAV() equals assetsDeposited, so totalAssets evaluates to 1.

intent_sources.text: For the very first deposit, sharesReceived should equal assetsToFulfill.
